results.title: T-Mobile Just Quietly Killed Its Better Value Phone Plan After Less Than a Year
results.description: T-Mobile launched new mobile plans this week by announcing “Nothing,” referring to the new EIP Flex 36 installment plan, with which you can get a new device for zero money down, not even taxes on the phone. But nothing is also what’s available if you wanted to sign up for T-Mobile’s recent Better Value plan, [...]
